exposure: Maternal hepatitis B e antigen (HBeAg) status
Maternal HBV DNA viral load before delivery
outcome: Newborn hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) positivity at birth
Newborn HBV DNA positivity at 7-12 months
Vertical transmission of hepatitis B virus (HBV)
cohort: Expectant mothers positive for hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) who underwent amniocentesis at The Third Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University, along with their 351 newborns.
finding: Among HBsAg-positive expectant mothers who underwent amniocentesis, one case of vertical transmission of hepatitis B to the newborn was identified, and a higher risk of HBsAg positivity at birth was associated with maternal HBeAg positivity or a high HBV DNA viral load (≥ 6 log10 IU/mL) before delivery.
